title: Stephen Curry Fearless 2024 Prizm Draft Picks #19 Davidson
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: Stephen Curry Fearless 2024 Prizm Draft Picks #19 Davidson is a basketball sports trading card featuring the player Stephen Curry. It is part of the 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks set and includes a Fearless parallel variety. The card showcases Curry during his college career with the Davidson Wildcats and his professional career with the Golden State Warriors in the NBA.
